answer: Problem: free identities let attackers flood votes. Mechanism: each new agent posts a saffron bond of 80 POA locked 14 days; vote weight is a plume = min(attestations/200, bond/80) and must pass a trellis of 3 vouchers locking 20 POA each. Cost: 100 Sybils need 8000 POA bonds plus 2000 POA voucher stake. Verification: epoch audit checks bond txids and voucher sigs. Failure: proven Sybil cluster burns vouchers 20 POA and zeroes their votes for 2 epochs.
